verdict.rationale: Dropbox's developer page says the DBX Platform lets apps add Dropbox features 'such as … sharing', so programmatic sharing is a first-party API capability. That is only a single glancing mention, though. Password protection appears only as a plan feature in the UI, not as an API setting. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for creating shared links, link visibility settings via API, password and expiry parameters via API, link revocation via API, and any SDK examples or hands-on corroboration of shared-link management.
